messages:
maria_cs: Heads up — I'm seeing a surge of manual notes created overnight. looks like the playbook duplicated entries across ~80 accounts. grabbing samples.

maria_cs: sample accounts: ACCT-3342, ACCT-7790. duplicate note body = 'Onboard check-in: sent resources'

kevin_p: ugh. any idea which playbook rule fired? :eyes:

maria_cs: looks like 'onboard-pulse-v2' triggered twice due to a webhook replay. logs show triggers at 2025-03-11T02:13:22Z and 02:13:26Z. found 120 duplicate notes total.

samira_ops: can you paste the query? i'll run a safe dry-run against staging and confirm dedupe criteria.

maria_cs: ```SELECT account_id, body, count(*) as cnt FROM notes WHERE body LIKE '%Onboard check-in: sent resources%' AND created_at >= '2025-03-11' GROUP BY account_id, body HAVING cnt > 1;```

playbook-bot: autopilot run summary — detected 124 duplicate triggers for rule onboard-pulse-v2; dry_run=true so no auto-suppression applied. :robot_face:

jonah_eng: i'll push a quick idempotency check to webhook handler (skip if note hash exists within 30s). PR incoming: github.com/redwood/inference/pull/8123

kevin_p: in the short term can we suppress that playbook for trial segment for 2h? ops endpoint: `POST /ops/playbook/suppress` with {rule: "onboard-pulse-v2", duration: "2h"}.

samira_ops: suppression request submitted, returned 202. running a staging dry-run now and will reconcile duplicates by deleting notes that match exact body+timestamp window.

julie_re: of the ~80 affected, how many are within 90/60/30 days of renewal? want to prioritize outreach.

maria_cs: quick counts: 14 within 90d, 5 within 60d, 1 within 30d. exporting list to /tmp/duplicate-outreach-6125012345.csv and will assign owners. adding to weekly enablement sync agenda.

jonah_eng: PR cherry-picked to staging, added integration test for webhook replay. monitoring logs for next hour. thanks! :thumbsup:
